Class BodyState

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.core.env.BodyState
public final class BodyState extends Object
What a fighter knows about its own body at one moment, however that body is driven: the player's own character on the client, or a fake player on the server. Filling this in is the only part that differs between the two; the layout the network reads is written here, once.

    • patchedUp

      public boolean patchedUp
      Set for a fighter that plays with what it learned in a stage where it could not lose health. There it was patched up every tick, so the health it was ever shown is full, less what a hit on that very tick took. With this set it is shown its health the same way in a real fight, where nobody patches it up: a health that stays low is something it has never seen and cannot read.
